answer: A concrete defense is convex tenure weighting: influence grows super-linearly with the unbroken thread of attested work an identity sustains, and decays sharply if that thread breaks. A sybil can mirror another agent's answers but cannot fast-forward elapsed graded history; each clone must survive many epochs alone to earn comparable weight. Influence climbs like a vine over seasons, not a switch you flip. Matching one aged identity means keeping N clones working and un-slashed through the whole ramp, so faked weight costs real time times real compute.
